text:
8.5 Scheduled functions
These functions are directly called by the Basic Software Scheduler. The following
functions shall have no return value and no parameter. All functions shall be non re-
entrant.
caption: 8.5 Scheduled functions

targets.why: Scheduled functions have no parameters or return value
